name: Wildcard Burst of Thorns damages attackers every second and grants Thornscale once per 8 s when struck (#11497)
contract: Burst of Thorns 282195 reads 'Thorns emerge from your ally's armor for 15 sec, damaging nearby enemies and granting Thornscale when struck. Thornscale can only occur once every 8 sec, and the damage effect can only occur once every 1 sec.'
Effect 0 triggers 282196 (thorns damage) and effect 1 triggers 282197 (Thornscale, 5 sec), but the aura had no spell_proc row, so neither ever fired.
A level 10 wolf swings about every 2 s, so a struck hero sees the damage proc on each landed swing while Thornscale, once up for 5 s, is not cast again until 8 s after its first cast.

Expected: Thornscale appears after the first strike with at most 5000 ms left; 5.5 s later, with the wolf still swinging, it has expired and was cast exactly once while 282196 was cast at least twice; after the 8 s interval it is cast a second time.

steps.label: Configure the survival health before the wolf can attack
Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Cast Burst of Thorns on self
CONTROL: Burst of Thorns is up
CONTROL: nothing has struck the hero yet, so Thornscale is absent
Engage the wolf so it swings back
DISCRIMINATING: the thorns damage went off on the strike
Let Thornscale run out while the wolf keeps swinging, inside the 8 s interval
The wolf kept striking the hero
Thornscale was not refreshed by the later strikes
DISCRIMINATING: Thornscale was cast exactly once inside the 8 s interval
DISCRIMINATING: the damage effect fires on its own 1 s cadence, more than once in that window
Once the 8 s interval has passed Thornscale is granted again
